notes: kb/Work PB369, PB5080, PB5139. Rule text (cite.py --check "§2023:14.9.16.3 SR4" "shall contain a GLOBAL clause" -> OK). The rule begins at 2002 (§2002:14.8.15.2 SR4, §2014:14.9.15.2 SR4; each checked with cite.py --check), so the row's editions are 2002, 2014 and 2023. There the summary-reporting GENERATE report-name-1 of a container's GLOBAL report is refused COBOL2392 when the report's FD is not GLOBAL, citing the rule of the edition compiled, and binds when it is; one check (RejectContainedReportFile) with INITIATE/TERMINATE and the file half of SR3. 1985 has no such rule (§1985:X.4.6.4 GR2), so --std 85 accepts it (kb/Work PB5080).
